skills.name: Count to 10, one by one
skills.homeTip: Count the spoons in a drawer together, touching each one as you say its number.

skills.name: Last number tells how many
skills.homeTip: Count 6 grapes, then ask "so how many grapes?" and listen for the last number.

skills.name: Find numbers on the line
skills.homeTip: Chalk a number line from 0 to 10 outside and jump to the number you call out.

skills.name: Quick look up to 5
skills.homeTip: Flash a few fingers for a moment and ask how many she saw without counting.

skills.name: Add within 10
skills.homeTip: Put 3 spoons on the table, add 2 more, and count them all together.

skills.name: Number pairs to 5
skills.homeTip: Split 5 grapes onto two plates in as many ways as you can.

skills.name: Add on the number line
skills.homeTip: Stand on a number on a chalk line and hop forward 2 or 3 steps. Where did you land?

skills.name: Make 10
skills.homeTip: Fill an egg carton cut to 10 cups with 7 pebbles. How many more fill it?

skills.name: Ten and some more (11 to 20)
skills.homeTip: Bundle 10 straws with a hair tie, add a few loose straws, and count on from ten.

skills.name: Find numbers to 20 on the line
skills.homeTip: Chalk a number line to 20 and jump to the numbers she calls out.

skills.name: Add within 20 by making ten
skills.homeTip: Put 8 spoons in an egg box of 10 and add 5 more. How many fill the box first, and how many are left over?

skills.name: Add on the number line to 20
skills.homeTip: Hop forward on the stairs, counting on from the step where you start.

skills.name: Take away within 20
skills.homeTip: Put 9 grapes on a plate, eat 3, and count what is left.

skills.name: Subtract by hopping back
skills.homeTip: Stand on a stair, step down 3, and say where you are.

skills.name: How many more
skills.homeTip: Line up her socks against yours. How many more does one of you have?

skills.name: Subtract within 20 with numbers
skills.homeTip: Ask "13 take away 4" at dinner and let her use fingers or spoons to check.

skills.name: Equal groups
skills.homeTip: Make 3 plates with 2 crackers each. How many crackers altogether?

skills.name: Rows of the same (arrays)
skills.homeTip: Set out 3 rows of 4 buttons. Count by rows: 4, 8, 12.

skills.name: Skip counting by 2, 5 and 10
skills.homeTip: Count shoes by twos, fingers by fives, and toes by tens.

skills.name: Multiply with numbers
skills.homeTip: Ask "3 groups of 4?" in the car and let her draw dots to check.

skills.name: Share fairly
skills.homeTip: Deal 12 grapes onto 3 plates, one at a time, round and round. How many on each plate?

skills.name: Put into equal groups
skills.homeTip: Put 10 socks into pairs. How many pairs?

skills.name: Divide with numbers
skills.homeTip: Ask "8 cookies shared by 2 people?" and let her share real cookies to check.

skills.name: Equal parts (halves, thirds, quarters)
skills.homeTip: Fold a paper in half, then in half again. How many equal parts now?

skills.name: Half and a quarter of a group
skills.homeTip: Share 8 raisins into 2 equal piles. One pile is half. How many is half?

skills.name: Fractions on a line from 0 to 1
skills.homeTip: Cut a ribbon into 4 equal parts and lay it out. Point to one quarter, two quarters, three quarters.

castle.first.speaker: sparkle
castle.first.text: Hi Siara! The stars need our help. Tap the big glowing button!

castle.back.speaker: sparkle
castle.back.text: Hi Siara! I'm so happy to see you. Tap the big glowing button!

map.pick.speaker: sparkle
map.pick.text: Tap the place that is glowing.

map.locked.speaker: sparkle
map.locked.text: Not yet. We'll get there together.

map.gardenAwake.speaker: sparkle
map.gardenAwake.text: The garden is awake now! Let's plant flowers.

map.practice.speaker: sparkle
map.practice.text: The garden wants a little more practice. Tap the glowing flowers!

map.done.speaker: sparkle
map.done.text: You helped the whole kingdom so far! Want to visit a place again?

sleeping.speaker: narrator
sleeping.text: Sparkle is sleeping. She'll be ready to play tomorrow.

quiet.speaker: narrator

warmup.intro.speaker: sparkle

wrapup.speaker: sparkle
wrapup.text: That was a lot of great thinking. Let's finish our story for today.

p1.open1.speaker: narrator
p1.open1.text: Once upon a time, in the Kingdom of Numbers, the night sky went dark.

p1.open2.speaker: sparkle
p1.open2.text: Hi Siara, I'm Sparkle! Oh no, the stars fell asleep. Will you help me wake them up?

p1.payoff.speaker: sparkle
p1.payoff.text: Five stars! The last number tells how many. Look, the sky is starting to glow!

p1.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
p1.goodbye.text: Today you learned to count each star just once. Goodnight, Siara!

p2.open1.speaker: narrator
p2.open1.text: The stars are waking up, but some are hiding in the clouds.

p2.open2.speaker: sparkle
p2.open2.text: Let's find out how many stars are in each cloud!

p2.payoff.speaker: sparkle
p2.payoff.text: You found every star in the clouds! The sky is getting brighter.

p2.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
p2.goodbye.text: Today you learned that the last number you say tells how many. Goodnight, Siara!

p3.open1.speaker: narrator
p3.open1.text: Sparkle wants to walk across the sky on a path of star stones.

p3.open2.speaker: sparkle
p3.open2.text: Every stone has a number. Will you show me where to hop?

p3.payoff.speaker: sparkle
p3.payoff.text: We crossed the whole star path! Every number has its own place.

p3.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
p3.goodbye.text: Today you learned where numbers live on the line. Goodnight, Siara!

p4.open1.speaker: narrator
p4.open1.text: The last stars are very shy. They only peek out for a moment.

p4.open2.speaker: sparkle
p4.open2.text: Look quickly, and tell me how many stars you see!

p4.payoff1.speaker: sparkle
p4.payoff1.text: You counted every star back into the sky!

p4.payoff2.speaker: sparkle
p4.payoff2.text: Look, the kingdom map is glowing. Today you learned that the last number you say tells how many.

p4.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
p4.goodbye.text: Goodnight, Siara! Tomorrow we can visit the garden.

g1.open1.speaker: narrator
g1.open1.text: Morning came to the kingdom, but the flower garden was still asleep.

g1.open2.speaker: sparkle
g1.open2.text: I can't find the path through the garden. Can we plant some flowers?

g1.payoff.speaker: sparkle
g1.payoff.text: Look at all the flowers! I can see the start of the path.

g1.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
g1.goodbye.text: Today you learned that adding means putting more together. Goodnight, Siara!

g2.open1.speaker: narrator
g2.open1.text: The garden bees have two flower beds, and they want flowers in both.

g2.open2.speaker: sparkle
g2.open2.text: Let's share the flowers between the beds in different ways!

g2.payoff.speaker: sparkle
g2.payoff.text: The bees are buzzing happily in both beds!

g2.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
g2.goodbye.text: Today you learned that a number can be split into two parts in many ways. Goodnight, Siara!

g3.open1.speaker: narrator
g3.open1.text: Stepping stones lead deeper into the garden.

g3.open2.speaker: sparkle
g3.open2.text: I love hopping! Count my hops with me.

g3.payoff.speaker: sparkle
g3.payoff.text: We hopped all the way along the path! Hopping forward is adding.

g3.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
g3.goodbye.text: Today you learned to add by hopping on the number line. Goodnight, Siara!

g4.open1.speaker: narrator
g4.open1.text: In the middle of the garden there is a sleeping fountain.

g4.open2.speaker: sparkle
g4.open2.text: The fountain wakes up when a flower box has ten flowers!

g4.payoff.speaker: sparkle
g4.payoff.text: Splash! The fountain is awake! Ten is a very special number.

g4.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
g4.goodbye.text: Today you learned how many more make ten. Goodnight, Siara!

g5.open1.speaker: narrator
g5.open1.text: Today is the garden festival, and everyone has come to see the flowers.

g5.open2.speaker: sparkle
g5.open2.text: Let's add the festival flowers together. You can use numbers now!

g5.payoff1.speaker: sparkle
g5.payoff1.text: You made the whole garden bloom! Today you learned that adding means putting together.

g5.payoff2.speaker: sparkle
g5.payoff2.text: And look... a bridge! I wonder what's across it.

g5.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
g5.goodbye.text: Goodnight, Siara! I can't wait to see you again.

practice.open1.speaker: narrator
practice.open1.text: Sparkle wants to play in the garden a little more.

practice.open2.speaker: sparkle
practice.open2.text: Let's practice together. Practice makes our brains strong!

practice.payoff.speaker: sparkle
practice.payoff.text: You worked so hard! The flowers are standing up tall.

practice.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
practice.goodbye.text: Thank you for practicing with me. Goodnight, Siara!

prompt.howMany.text: How many stars are in the cloud? Touch a number to hear it. Touch it again to choose.

ask.numberBond.speaker: sparkle
ask.numberBond.text: How many flowers are in the other bed now?

prompt.addMore.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.addMore.pictorial.text: {a} flowers are awake, and {b} more just bloomed. How many flowers are there now?

prompt.addMore.speaker: sparkle
prompt.addMore.text: {a} flowers and {b} more. How many flowers?

prompt.numberBond.speaker: sparkle

prompt.hop.speaker: sparkle

prompt.makeTen.speaker: sparkle

hint.model.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.text: Hmm, not quite. Let's look again. Touch each one and count.

hint.model.addMore.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.addMore.text: Hmm, not quite. Let's count them together. Touch each flower.

hint.model.makeTen.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.makeTen.text: Hmm, not quite. Look at the empty spots in the box. Each empty spot needs a flower.

hint.model.hop.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.hop.text: Hmm, not quite. Let's hop again, one stone for each horseshoe.

hint.model.numberBond.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.numberBond.text: Hmm, not quite. Count the flowers that still need a bed.

hint.worked.countTap.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.countTap.text: Let's count together slowly. Watch each star light up.

hint.worked.howMany.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.howMany.text: Let's count together slowly. Watch each star light up.

hint.worked.quickLook.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.quickLook.text: Let's look one more time and count together.

hint.worked.findOnLine.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.findOnLine.text: Let's count the stones together, from zero to {a}.

hint.worked.makeTen.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.makeTen.text: Let's count the empty spots together.

hint.worked.numberBond.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.numberBond.text: Let's count the flowers that are left, together.

reveal.speaker: sparkle
reveal.text: It's {answer}! Let's see why together. We'll practice this again soon.

praise.countTap.speaker: sparkle
praise.countTap.text: {a} stars! The last number tells how many.

praise.hop.speaker: sparkle
praise.hop.text: We landed on {answer}! {a} and {b} more make {answer}.

tryAgain.speaker: sparkle
tryAgain.text: Try again. You can do it.

b1.open1.speaker: narrator
b1.open1.text: Beyond the garden, an old bridge crossed a sparkling river. But its planks had fallen into the water.

b1.open2.speaker: sparkle
b1.open2.text: Look, Siara! A beaver keeps the planks tied in bundles of ten. Let's count how many we have.

b1.payoff.speaker: sparkle
b1.payoff.text: Click! The first part of the bridge is back. Ten and some more makes a teen number!

b1.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
b1.goodbye.text: Today you learned that thirteen is ten and three more. Goodnight, Siara!

b2.open1.speaker: narrator
b2.open1.text: Stepping stones cross the shallow part of the river. Each one has a number, all the way to twenty.

b2.open2.speaker: sparkle
b2.open2.text: Help me find the right stone so I don't get my hooves wet!

b2.payoff.speaker: sparkle
b2.payoff.text: We crossed every stone! Twenty is two tens.

b2.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
b2.goodbye.text: Today you found numbers all the way to twenty. Goodnight, Siara!

b3.open1.speaker: narrator
b3.open1.text: Each part of the bridge has two plank boxes. The first box must be full before the second one holds.

b3.open2.speaker: sparkle
b3.open2.text: Let's fill the first box to ten, then put the rest in the next box.

b3.payoff.speaker: sparkle
b3.payoff.text: Another part of the bridge is fixed! Making ten first makes adding easy.

b3.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
b3.goodbye.text: Today you added by making ten first. Goodnight, Siara!

b4.open1.speaker: narrator
b4.open1.text: A long log runs beside the bridge, marked with stones from zero to twenty.

b4.open2.speaker: sparkle
b4.open2.text: I can hop a long way today! Count my hops with me.

b4.payoff.speaker: sparkle
b4.payoff.text: Boing! We hopped all the way along the log.

b4.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
b4.goodbye.text: Today you added by hopping on to twenty. Goodnight, Siara!

b5.open1.speaker: narrator
b5.open1.text: Only the last part of the bridge is missing. The beaver has brought all the planks.

b5.open2.speaker: sparkle
b5.open2.text: Let's put the bridge together, Siara. You can use numbers now!

b5.payoff1.speaker: sparkle
b5.payoff1.text: You rebuilt the whole bridge! Today you learned that teen numbers are ten and some more.

b5.payoff2.speaker: sparkle
b5.payoff2.text: Look, on the other side... is that a cave? I can hear someone grumbling about gems.

b5.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
b5.goodbye.text: Goodnight, Siara! We'll cross the bridge together next time.

prompt.tensOnes.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.tensOnes.concrete.text: Here is a bundle of ten planks and some loose ones. Tap each loose plank and count on from ten.

prompt.tensOnes.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.tensOnes.pictorial.text: A bundle of ten and {b} more planks. How many planks is that?

prompt.tensOnes.speaker: sparkle
prompt.tensOnes.text: Ten and {b} more. How many is that?

ask.tensOnes.speaker: sparkle
ask.tensOnes.text: How many planks are there altogether?

hint.model.tensOnes.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.tensOnes.text: Hmm, not quite. Look at the bundle. It already has ten planks inside.

hint.worked.tensOnes.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.tensOnes.text: Let's start at ten and count on, one plank at a time.

prompt.findOnLine.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.findOnLine.concrete.text: Can you help me hop to {a}? Tap the stone where {a} lives.

prompt.bridgeAdd.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.bridgeAdd.concrete.text: This span has {a} planks. Let's add {b} more. Fill the first box to ten, then use the next box.

prompt.bridgeAdd.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.bridgeAdd.pictorial.text: {a} planks and {b} more. How many planks altogether?

prompt.bridgeAdd.speaker: sparkle
prompt.bridgeAdd.text: {a} plus {b}. If you want help, tap the plank boxes.

ask.bridgeAdd.speaker: sparkle
ask.bridgeAdd.text: How many planks are there now?

hint.model.bridgeAdd.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.bridgeAdd.text: Hmm, not quite. Look at the first box. How many more fill it to ten?

hint.worked.bridgeAdd.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.bridgeAdd.text: Let's count on from {a}, filling the box to ten first.

praise.bridgeAdd.speaker: sparkle
praise.bridgeAdd.text: Yes! {a} and {b} make {answer}. You filled the ten first!

k1.open1.speaker: narrator
k1.open1.text: Across the bridge was a dark cave. Inside lived a grumpy goblin named Grub, who loved shiny gems.

k1.open2.speaker: sparkle
k1.open2.text: Oh no, Siara! Grub is taking the kingdom's gems. Let's find out how many are left each time.

k1.payoff.speaker: sparkle
k1.payoff.text: We counted every gem that was left. Taking away makes the number smaller.

k1.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
k1.goodbye.text: Today you learned that taking away means some are gone. Goodnight, Siara!

k2.open1.speaker: narrator
k2.open1.text: Grub's tunnel has stepping stones, and the way home goes backwards.

k2.open2.speaker: sparkle
k2.open2.text: Let's hop back toward the entrance. Count my hops with me!

k2.payoff.speaker: sparkle
k2.payoff.text: We hopped all the way back! Hopping back is taking away.

k2.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
k2.goodbye.text: Today you subtracted by hopping back on the line. Goodnight, Siara!

k3.open1.speaker: narrator
k3.open1.text: Grub says he has more gems than Siara. Is that true?

k3.open2.speaker: sparkle
k3.open2.text: Let's line up the gems, one next to one, and see who has more.

k3.payoff.speaker: sparkle
k3.payoff.text: Lining them up shows who has more, and how many more!

k3.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
k3.goodbye.text: Today you found how many more by matching. Goodnight, Siara!

k4.open1.speaker: narrator
k4.open1.text: Grub hid the gems in bags of ten, with a few loose ones beside them.

k4.open2.speaker: sparkle
k4.open2.text: When he takes more than the loose ones, we can take from the ten!

k4.payoff.speaker: sparkle
k4.payoff.text: Grub is surprised! You can take away from teen numbers too.

k4.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
k4.goodbye.text: Today you took away from numbers up to twenty. Goodnight, Siara!

k5.open1.speaker: narrator
k5.open1.text: Grub sits on his gem pile, looking a little lonely.

k5.open2.speaker: sparkle
k5.open2.text: Let's work out the gems with numbers. Maybe Grub will give them back!

k5.payoff1.speaker: sparkle
k5.payoff1.text: Grub says sorry and gives the gems back! Today you learned that subtracting finds what is left, or how many more.

k5.payoff2.speaker: sparkle
k5.payoff2.text: And look, Grub has an invitation... to a Royal Ball! I wonder who will be there.

k5.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
k5.goodbye.text: Goodnight, Siara! Even grumpy goblins can be friends.

hint.worked.takeAway.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.takeAway.text: Let's count the gems that are left, together.

prompt.compare.concrete.text: You have {a} gems and Grub has {b}. Tap your gems that have no partner.

prompt.compare.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.compare.pictorial.text: You have {a} gems and Grub has {b}. How many more do you have?

ask.compare.speaker: sparkle

hint.model.compare.speaker: sparkle

hint.worked.compare.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.compare.text: Let's count the gems with no partner, together.

praise.compare.speaker: sparkle

hint.model.subtraction.speaker: sparkle

hint.worked.subtraction.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.subtraction.text: Let's take them away one at a time and count what is left.

r1.open1.speaker: narrator
r1.open1.text: Grub's invitation was real. The Queen was holding a Royal Ball, and everyone was invited!

r1.open2.speaker: sparkle
r1.open2.text: Every table must have the same number of guests. Let's count the seats, Siara!

r1.payoff.speaker: sparkle
r1.payoff.text: Every guest has a seat! Equal groups make counting easy.

r1.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
r1.goodbye.text: Today you counted equal groups. Goodnight, Siara!

r2.open1.speaker: narrator
r2.open1.text: For the music, the chairs stand in neat rows, the same number in every row.

r2.open2.speaker: sparkle
r2.open2.text: Let's count the chairs row by row!

r2.payoff.speaker: sparkle
r2.payoff.text: The musicians are ready! Rows of the same make counting fast.

r2.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
r2.goodbye.text: Today you counted rows of chairs. Goodnight, Siara!

r3.open1.speaker: narrator
r3.open1.text: The dance floor has numbered tiles, and the Royal Dance uses big hops.

r3.open2.speaker: sparkle
r3.open2.text: Each hop jumps over the same number of tiles. Count the hops with me!

r3.payoff.speaker: sparkle
r3.payoff.text: What a dance! Counting by twos, fives and tens is like hopping.

r3.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
r3.goodbye.text: Today you skip counted. Goodnight, Siara!

r4.open1.speaker: narrator
r4.open1.text: The Ball begins! The Queen asks Siara to help with the last seating plans.

r4.open2.speaker: sparkle
r4.open2.text: You can use numbers now, Siara. Times means groups of!

r4.payoff1.speaker: sparkle
r4.payoff1.text: Everyone is dancing! Today you learned that times means equal groups.

r4.payoff2.speaker: sparkle
r4.payoff2.text: The Queen says the feast is next... but she is worried there won't be enough to share.

r4.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
r4.goodbye.text: Goodnight, Siara! Save some energy for the feast.

prompt.groups.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.groups.concrete.text: There are {a} tables, with {b} guests at each. Tap each guest to count them all.

prompt.groups.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.groups.pictorial.text: {a} tables with {b} guests at each. How many guests are there?

ask.groups.speaker: sparkle
ask.groups.text: How many guests are at the tables?

hint.model.groups.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.groups.text: Hmm, not quite. Look at one table. It has {b} guests. Every table is the same.

hint.worked.groups.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.groups.text: Let's count on, one table at a time.

prompt.array.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.array.concrete.text: There are {a} rows with {b} chairs in each. Tap each row and count by rows.

prompt.array.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.array.pictorial.text: {a} rows of {b} chairs. How many chairs?

hint.model.array.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.array.text: Hmm, not quite. Each row has {b} chairs. Count by {b}s.

hint.worked.array.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.array.text: Let's count row by row, adding {b} each time.

prompt.skipHop.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.skipHop.concrete.text: Each hop jumps {b} tiles. I'll hop {a} times. Tap the hop button and count with me!

prompt.skipHop.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.skipHop.pictorial.text: I hopped {a} times, {b} tiles each hop. Where did I land?

prompt.skipHop.speaker: sparkle
prompt.skipHop.text: {a} hops of {b}. Tap where I land.

ask.skipHop.speaker: sparkle
ask.skipHop.text: Where did I land? Tap the tile.

hint.model.skipHop.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.skipHop.text: Hmm, not quite. Each hop is {b} tiles long. Count by {b}s.

praise.skipHop.speaker: sparkle
praise.skipHop.text: We landed on {answer}! {a} hops of {b} is {answer}.

prompt.multiply.speaker: sparkle
prompt.multiply.text: {a} times {b}. If you want help, tap the guests.

hint.model.multiply.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.multiply.text: Hmm, not quite. Think of {a} groups with {b} in each.

f1.open1.speaker: narrator
f1.open1.text: After the dancing, everyone was hungry. The royal cooks had made a feast!

f1.open2.speaker: sparkle
f1.open2.text: The Queen says every plate must get the same. Let's share fairly, one at a time!

f1.payoff.speaker: sparkle
f1.payoff.text: Every plate has the same! That's what fair means.

f1.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
f1.goodbye.text: Today you shared things fairly. Goodnight, Siara!

f2.open1.speaker: narrator
f2.open1.text: The berry pickers came back with heaps of berries, and baskets that hold the same amount.

f2.open2.speaker: sparkle
f2.open2.text: Let's fill each basket until it's full, then start the next one.

f2.payoff.speaker: sparkle
f2.payoff.text: All the berries are in baskets! Making equal groups tells us how many groups.

f2.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
f2.goodbye.text: Today you made equal groups. Goodnight, Siara!

f3.open1.speaker: narrator
f3.open1.text: More guests came to the big table, and the cooks brought more treats.

f3.open2.speaker: sparkle
f3.open2.text: Bigger numbers, same idea. Fair shares for everyone!

f3.payoff.speaker: sparkle
f3.payoff.text: Everyone at the big table is smiling. Sharing works for big numbers too.

f3.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
f3.goodbye.text: Today you shared even bigger piles. Goodnight, Siara!

f4.open1.speaker: narrator
f4.open1.text: The feast is nearly over, and the last treats wait on the table.

f4.open2.speaker: sparkle
f4.open2.text: You can use numbers now, Siara. Divide means share fairly!

f4.payoff1.speaker: sparkle
f4.payoff1.text: Everyone had enough! Today you learned that dividing means sharing fairly into equal groups.

f4.payoff2.speaker: sparkle
f4.payoff2.text: Oh! Look up at the sky. The moon has a crack in it. Someone needs to mend the Moon Crystal.

f4.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
f4.goodbye.text: Goodnight, Siara! The moon is waiting for us.

prompt.share.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.share.concrete.text: We have {a} cupcakes and {b} plates. Tap the pile to put one on each plate, round and round.

prompt.share.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.share.pictorial.text: {a} treats shared fairly onto {b} plates. How many on each plate?

ask.share.speaker: sparkle
ask.share.text: How many treats are on each plate?

hint.model.share.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.share.text: Hmm, not quite. Look at just one plate and count what is on it.

hint.worked.share.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.share.text: Let's count the treats on one plate, together.

praise.share.speaker: sparkle
praise.share.text: Yes! {a} shared by {b} is {answer} each. That's fair!

prompt.groupInto.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.groupInto.concrete.text: We have {a} berries. Each basket holds {b}. Tap the pile to fill the baskets.

prompt.groupInto.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.groupInto.pictorial.text: {a} berries, {b} in each basket. How many baskets?

prompt.groupInto.speaker: sparkle
prompt.groupInto.text: {a} in groups of {b}. How many groups?

ask.groupInto.speaker: sparkle
ask.groupInto.text: How many baskets did we fill?

hint.model.groupInto.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.groupInto.text: Hmm, not quite. Count the baskets, not the berries.

hint.worked.groupInto.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.groupInto.text: Let's count the full baskets together.

prompt.divide.speaker: sparkle
prompt.divide.text: {a} divided by {b}. If you want help, tap the plates.

hint.model.divide.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.divide.text: Hmm, not quite. Think of {a} treats shared onto {b} plates.

hint.worked.divide.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.divide.text: Let's share them one at a time and count one plate.

m1.open1.speaker: narrator
m1.open1.text: High above the kingdom, the Moon Crystal had cracked into pieces.

m1.open2.speaker: sparkle
m1.open2.text: To mend it, every piece must be the same size. Let's count the equal parts!

m1.payoff.speaker: sparkle
m1.payoff.text: The pieces fit! Equal parts means every part is the same size.

m1.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
m1.goodbye.text: Today you learned about halves, thirds and quarters. Goodnight, Siara!

m2.open1.speaker: narrator
m2.open1.text: Moonstones lay scattered on the hill. Half must go to the left of the moon, half to the right.

m2.open2.speaker: sparkle
m2.open2.text: Let's share the moonstones into equal piles. One pile is one part.

m2.payoff.speaker: sparkle
m2.payoff.text: The moon is glowing on both sides! Half means one of two equal parts.

m2.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
m2.goodbye.text: Today you found half and a quarter of a group. Goodnight, Siara!

m3.open1.speaker: narrator
m3.open1.text: A moonbeam stretches from the ground, at zero, all the way up to the moon, at one.

m3.open2.speaker: sparkle
m3.open2.text: The moonbeam has equal steps. Help me find the right step!

m3.payoff.speaker: sparkle
m3.payoff.text: We walked the whole moonbeam! Fractions live between zero and one.

m3.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
m3.goodbye.text: Today you found fractions on a line. Goodnight, Siara!

m4.open1.speaker: narrator
m4.open1.text: The last piece of the Moon Crystal is waiting.

m4.open2.speaker: sparkle
m4.open2.text: Use everything you know, Siara. Let's mend the moon!

m4.payoff1.speaker: sparkle
m4.payoff1.text: You mended the Moon Crystal! The whole kingdom is shining. You learned so much, Siara.

m4.payoff2.speaker: sparkle
m4.payoff2.text: Stars, flowers, a bridge, gems, a ball, a feast, and now the moon. Thank you for saving the Kingdom of Numbers!

m4.goodbye.speaker: sparkle
m4.goodbye.text: Goodnight, Siara. I'll always be here when you want to play.

prompt.parts.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.parts.concrete.text: The crystal broke into equal parts. Tap each part to count them.

prompt.parts.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.parts.pictorial.text: The crystal broke into equal parts. How many parts are there?

prompt.parts.speaker: sparkle
prompt.parts.text: How many equal parts make the whole crystal?

ask.parts.speaker: sparkle
ask.parts.text: How many equal parts are there?

hint.model.parts.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.parts.text: Hmm, not quite. Touch each part once, and count.

praise.parts.speaker: sparkle
praise.parts.text: Yes! {answer} equal parts. Each part is one {answer}th... we say one half, one third or one quarter!

prompt.fractionOf.concrete.speaker: sparkle
prompt.fractionOf.concrete.text: We have {a} moonstones. Share them into {b} equal piles. Tap the pile to share.

prompt.fractionOf.pictorial.speaker: sparkle
prompt.fractionOf.pictorial.text: {a} moonstones in {b} equal piles. How many are in one pile?

prompt.fractionOf.speaker: sparkle
prompt.fractionOf.text: One part out of {b} equal parts of {a}. How many is that?

ask.fractionOf.speaker: sparkle
ask.fractionOf.text: How many moonstones are in one pile?

hint.model.fractionOf.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.fractionOf.text: Hmm, not quite. Look at just one pile.

praise.fractionOf.speaker: sparkle
praise.fractionOf.text: Yes! One part of {a} in {b} equal parts is {answer}.

prompt.fractionLine.speaker: sparkle
prompt.fractionLine.text: The moonbeam has {b} equal steps. Tap the step for {a} out of {b}.

hint.model.fractionLine.speaker: sparkle
hint.model.fractionLine.text: Hmm, not quite. Count the steps from zero.

hint.worked.fractionLine.speaker: sparkle
hint.worked.fractionLine.text: Let's count the steps from zero together, up to {a}.

praise.fractionLine.speaker: sparkle
praise.fractionLine.text: Yes! That's {a} out of {b} steps along the moonbeam.
